lines.text: Paul writes a bold reminder because of God's grace, so he can be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles.
Paul has fully proclaimed the gospel from Jerusalem around to Galatia, aspiring to preach where Christ was not known.
Having longed for many years to visit Rome, Paul hopes to see the believers on his way to Spain.
Paul is on his way to Jerusalem, because Cyprus and Achaia contributed for the poor among the saints there.
Paul urges the believers to pray that he is delivered from the unbelievers in Judea and may come with joy.
